title.narrative: IDF - Procurement Reforms and Capacity Development

description.narrative: " IDF Grant is to support the implementation of the Action Plan for publi procurement reforms and procurement capacity buildingcomma through the provision of TA. This would enable Tonga to establish a legal framework for public procurement; have procurement manuals along with standard procurement documents; and develop the capacity of Government officials in managing public procurement. It is envisaged that there would be significant efficiency gains in processing public procurement and more transparency in the award of contracts. Note: The request for IDF financing clearly indicates that the CMU has provided adequate funds for the supervision of the Grant in FY04 under the Tonga OPR. (Since a PAD is not prepared for IDF operationscomma the information was taken/adapted from the document ""Request for IDF Financing""). DO: to support the implementation of public procurement reforms and procurement capacity building Outcome 1: Preparation and enactment of a Procurement Actcomma and ancillary Regulations Outcome 2: Preparation and utilization Procurement Manualscomma along with standard procurement documents Outcome 3: Capacity development of Government officials in public procurement"
